caption: "kate upton" — 200,000+ searches this week. Her husband just threw his last pitch.

Why: Justin Verlander made the last start of his 21-season career on September 26 in Detroit, where it began. His 7-year-old daughter ran out to take him off the mound, a surprise Upton planned with manager A.J. Hinch. "I was sobbing," he said.

What most people don't know: in 2016 Verlander got 14 first-place Cy Young votes to Rick Porcello's 8 and still lost, 137 to 132, because two writers left him off their ballots. Upton called out the voters on Twitter. He won the award in 2019 and 2022.
Very simply put: 21 seasons, 3 Cy Youngs, and a 7-year-old had the last word.
